purpose: HoloMed-D Phase 2 real chest X-ray engineering validation. Research/engineering use only; not a diagnostic result.

retrieved_via.note: Test images shipped in the TorchXRayVision repository (the same project that publishes the densenet121-res224-all weights). Downloaded from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit; size and git blob SHA-1 verified against the GitHub contents API.

cases.modality: Chest radiograph (NIH release does not carry a DICOM modality tag)
cases.format: PNG, 8-bit grayscale, 512x512 as shipped in the TorchXRayVision repo (downsampled copy; dataset metadata lists original size 2682x2749)
cases.public_deidentified: Public, de-identified research dataset released by the NIH Clinical Center
cases.label_source: Data_Entry_2017_v2020.csv.gz bundled with the installed torchxrayvision 1.5.4 package; looked up at runtime by validate_real_cxr.py
cases.label_caveat: ChestX-ray14 labels were mined from radiology reports with NLP/text mining. They are not radiologist-confirmed per-image ground truth and carry known label noise.

cases.dataset: SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation (images derived from NIH ChestX-ray14)
cases.format: DICOM, JPEG Baseline (Process 1) transfer syntax, 8-bit, MONOCHROME2, 1024x1024
cases.public_deidentified: Public challenge dataset; PatientName/PatientID are random UUIDs, StudyDate is the placeholder 19010101, no institution tag
cases.label_source: siim-pneumothorax-train-rle.csv.gz bundled with the installed torchxrayvision 1.5.4 package; looked up at runtime by validate_real_cxr.py
cases.label_caveat: The SIIM-ACR annotation covers pneumothorax only. EncodedPixels == -1 means no pneumothorax mask was annotated; it says nothing about any other finding.
cases.redistribution_note: Kaggle competition data is subject to the competition rules. Review licensing before committing this file to a repository.

rejected_candidates.reason: InstitutionName is 'FU Berlin, Veterinärmedizin Düppel' (veterinary); likely not a human chest radiograph. Also JPEG-LS compressed with no installed decoder.
Not an image: a 14-byte text file containing '404: Not Found' from an earlier failed download. Left untouched.
